assets.name: 炉火酒馆
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production background wallpaper for a Chinese roleplay reading/chat application, one original full-bleed landscape image, 16:9 aspect ratio, preferably 2560x1440 or larger. Not a UI mockup.
Style/medium: refined atmospheric environment concept painting, semi-realistic matte painting, restrained painterly texture, believable materials and perspective, elegant and immersive. A cohesive quiet world, neither cartoon nor a hyper-sharp game screenshot.
Composition: environmental scene only, unoccupied. Broad and coherent shapes, soft depth, low-frequency detail across the central reading area; interesting environment details mostly around the edges. Must also remain pleasant when center-cropped to a narrow mobile portrait background. No person, face, text, letters, signage, logo, watermark, frame, border or collage.
Lighting: controlled local contrast, lifted shadows, gentle highlights, muted colors. Rich enough to use as a wallpaper, composed to stay calm underneath text once an app applies its own opacity. Do not pre-composite an application overlay, text area, gradient panel, or blank rectangle.

Primary request: an inviting old fantasy tavern interior on a quiet evening. Warm amber lantern light grazes aged oak beams, stone walls and a worn wooden floor. A small glowing hearth and shelves of earthenware sit toward the side; simple empty tables and chairs suggest a welcoming stop on a long journey. The center has a calm, open passage through the room into soft warm shadow. A hint of cool dusk through small windows balances the amber. Intimate, tranquil, lived-in, with subtle wood grain and a faint veil of warm air. Medium-wide eye-level view, natural architectural proportions. Avoid bright white flames, foreground clutter, dramatic spotlighting and excessive candle dots.

Primary request: a serene wild valley just after sunrise, with layered mountain ridges dissolving into pearl-gray mist. A narrow stream winds between soft grasses and low wild shrubs in the foreground; a few dark evergreen silhouettes frame the outer edges. Expansive pale mist opens through the middle of the view, and distant slopes barely catch a muted cool-gold dawn. Quiet sage green, slate blue, soft stone gray and a trace of warm light. A believable natural landscape with painterly restraint, spacious, restful and inviting exploration. Avoid bright sun disks, saturated emerald foliage, oversized focal trees and dramatic hard rock detail in the center.

Primary request: a quiet old seaside harbor at blue hour in gentle rain. Slate-blue water, soft silhouettes of simple moored wooden boats, distant weathered harbor buildings with a few muted amber windows. A rain-darkened stone quay recedes gently along one edge; most of the center is calm water and soft atmospheric distance. A low sea mist unites buildings, boat masts and the horizon. Restrained reflections, diffused overcast sky, no blazing moon or neon. Wistful, sheltered and contemplative, as if a story could begin after the rain. Muted indigo, sea gray and tiny warm accents; weathered materials suggested rather than over-rendered.
